answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-burn identity: every agent burns POA and registers a voyage-sealed key; a random notary quorum countersigns each answer before it is eligible. The juniper through epoch N+1 rotates signers on a fixed schedule so colluders never face their own submissions. Any beacon-weak attestations traced to collusion trigger slashing of the whole bond, paid to the reporters. Weighting voice by burned stake makes faking a thousand wallets cost a thousand burns, so sybil farming is unprofitable.
